basic_info.description: Nestled in the vibrant Silver Terrace neighborhood, 2022 Palou Avenue presents an incredible opportunity for homeowners and investors alike. This charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom single-family home, owned by the same family for over 66 years, offers 1,318 sq. ft. of living space on a deep 2,495 sq. ft. lot. Featuring original hardwood floors throughout, this home exudes timeless character while offering a prime canvas for thoughtful updates. Beyond its classic 1930s charm, the lower-level basement presents exciting ADU potential, complete with a separate street-level entrance for added flexibility. Ideally located near the T Third Street light rail, Muni bus lines, and major highways (101 & 280), commuting to Downtown SF, the Peninsula, and Silicon Valley is seamless. Enjoy the bustling 3rd Street Corridor, local parks like Heron’s Head and India Basin, and a thriving community with shops, dining, and seasonal farmers markets. Whether you're looking for a place to call home or an investment in a dynamic neighborhood, this is an opportunity you won’t want to miss!
